tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page and panel background.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: The one card that leads a screen (the planner answer). Other blocks sit on surface-page with a line border.

tokens.name: surface-lane
tokens.usage: Neutral pills, number chips, quiet info blocks, row dividers inside a list.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and list borders, secondary button border, meter track (the empty part of a usage bar).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, the used part of the mark, primary buttons (as fill), the pace tick on a meter.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting sentences under a headline, executor reasons, footnotes on surface-page. 7.7:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, section labels, times and secondary numbers. 4.8:1 on surface-page light; never on surface-lane for body text.

tokens.name: ink-on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (primary button, rank chip 1).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Brand accent. ONLY the mark's pace tick and brand moments. Never a status, a button or a link, so the brand never reads as 'on pace' by accident.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links. 6.7:1 light.

tokens.name: good-fg
tokens.usage: Text in a good pill (Available, On pace, Ready) on good-bg.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Good pill background.

tokens.name: good-fill
tokens.usage: Usage-bar fill when on pace; live dot; check marks.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Text in a warn pill (Ahead of pace, Limited until …) on warn-bg; stuck-task glyph.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warn pill background.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Usage-bar fill when ahead of pace or near a limit.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a warn attention card.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warn attention card.

tokens.name: bad-fg
tokens.usage: Text in a bad pill (Not working, Out of quota) on bad-bg; failure glyph.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Bad pill background; count badge on Needs attention.

tokens.name: bad-fill
tokens.usage: Usage-bar fill when exhausted; unavailable dots.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of a failed-task attention card.

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a failed-task attention card.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text in an info pill (Planner, Review, Working) on info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info pill background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in the app and docs; one per screen.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The lowercase wordmark next to the mark. 15px in the panel header.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: The planner's used percentage. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: You're on pace for the week.
styles.usage: The one-sentence answer at the top of a screen, and card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Claude has 70% left with 4 days 20 hours to go.
styles.usage: All running text and list rows.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in a list row (executor, account, task goal).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second line of a list row, meter captions, times. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, branch names, paths. Always selectable.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a name and its caption.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a row or pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; between a section label and its content.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List-row padding; attention-card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in the panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page padding in the app and docs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rank chips, monogram tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the app icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, lists, attention cards, the primary action bar buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large showcase panels (brand pages, onboarding).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, meters, dots.
